full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 6
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Agenda
Monday, Jestha 4, 2083
11:00 AM
1. Letter from the Office of the President
The Honorable Speaker will read out the letter from the Office of the President regarding the reshuffle of the Council of Ministers.
2. Reshuffle in the Business Transaction Committee
The Honorable Speaker will reshuffle the names of the Honorable Members in the Business Transaction Committee.
3. Discussion on the Report
The Honorable Chairperson of the House of Representatives Regulations Drafting Committee, Ganesh Parajuli, will present a proposal for consideration on the "Report of the House of Representatives Regulations Drafting Committee, 2083".
4. Discussion on the Principles and Priorities of the Appropriation Bill
Discussion will commence on "Regarding the Principles and Priorities of the Appropriation Bill for the Fiscal Year 2083/084 (excluding tax proposals)".
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: The Speaker will read a letter from the Office of the President concerning a reshuffle in the Council of Ministers. Following this, the Speaker will announce changes to the membership of the Business Transaction Committee.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: The Chairperson of the House of Representatives Regulations Drafting Committee will present a proposal for discussion on the committee's report. Subsequently, the House will begin discussing the principles and priorities of the Appropriation Bill for FY 2083/084, excluding tax proposals.
